## Why

Frontend design review of 2026-10-25 (opus, from four owner screenshots; it did not read docs/dashboard.md or adj 149, so check the spec first). The live run is the one thing the owner supervises, but Overview shows eight identical decision rows first, the run as one highlighted line, and the detail at the bottom after up to six blank lines.
